parties.petitioner: Judgebir Singh @ Jasbir Singh Samra @ Jasbir & Ors.

summary: The appellants, accused under IPC, UAPA and the Explosive Substances Act, challenged the High Court's dismissal of their appeal against denial of default bail. Key issues: whether a chargesheet filed without valid sanction is invalid for purposes of Section 167(2) CrPC; whether mere filing of chargesheet suffices to bar default bail; whether failure to obtain sanction under UAPA entitles accused to bail; and whether filing chargesheet before Magistrate instead of Special Court under NIA Act vitiates proceedings. Court analyzed filing timeline, extension of investigation under UAPA, and sanction requirements under UAPA and the 1908 Act.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 167(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
Section 43D(2)(b) of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967
